create_ImageClassificationParams: create an ImageClassificationParams instance with custom learning rate and batch size for image classification training
configure_ImageClassificationParams_vit_: configure ImageClassificationParams to use a ViT model with fp16 mixed precision and gradient accumulation
configure_ImageClassificationParams_earl: configure ImageClassificationParams with early stopping patience and threshold for image classification
configure_ImageClassificationParams_hub_: configure ImageClassificationParams to push the trained model to Hugging Face Hub with a token
review_ImageClassificationParams_default: review the default training parameters in ImageClassificationParams including optimizer, scheduler, and seed settings
